scope: Two completed 90-group pilot comparisons. B is the fixed training/reward/acceptance model, not DFT truth. E21 extends one continuous training trajectory to 1024 groups; these pilots do not establish convergence.

direct.scope: Fresh raw B-defined task; no force gate or new DFT. Unique novel hits are deduplicated within each 128-proposal request/seed pool and averaged; cross-request unique graph counts are separate. Shuffled controls exactly permute the same conditional inputs and random streams, so are not independent new proposals. B is both training target and acceptance, not independent accuracy.
